outlook.statement: Despite the pesticide industry growing at an annual rate of 8-10% driven by climatic conditions and minimum support prices, the sector faces critical structural challenges. The Company is adopting a cautious approach towards its pesticide formulations business for the financial year 2026-27. The Company is evaluating a strategic shift towards high margin, remunerative alternative products and actively exploring various strategic options for diversification mainly into construction and fabrication products.

The outlook for the Indian agrochemical industry remains positive, supported by Government initiatives to enhance agricultural productivity, scientific farming practices, and increasing demand for quality crop protection products. The Company remains focused on operational excellence, sustainable growth, prudent financial management, and creating long-term value for stakeholders.

The Company has incurred losses for the last three consecutive years resulting in continuous erosion of net worth and depletion of accumulated reserves. Further, the Company's turnover has declined year on year and trade receivables have aged significantly with low subsequent collections. These conditions indicate the existence of a material uncertainty that may cast significant doubt on the Company's ability to continue as a going concern.

The Company is adopting a cautious approach towards its pesticide formulations business for the financial year 2026-27 and is proposing to lease out its idle manufacturing capacity to maximize asset efficiency and generate steady revenue streams.

The Company is evaluating a strategic shift towards high margin, remunerative alternative products and is actively exploring various strategic options for diversification mainly into construction and fabrication products to tap into the robust and growing demand within the infrastructure and industrial construction sectors.
